```{python}
#| label: generar-figuras
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "docs" else Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "docs" / "lancet"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import render_helpers as rh
from report_helpers import kpis, number, show_table
import pandas as pd

# The four panel figures are rebuilt here, at render time, from docs/lancet/data (tidy and verified tables).
started = time.time()
build = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "figuras_principales.py"], cwd=ROOT / "docs" / "lancet", capture_output=True, text=True)
if build.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError(build.stderr[-3000:])
qa = pd.DataFrame(json.loads((ROOT / "docs" / "lancet" / "qa" / "figuras_principales_qa.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
qa_view = qa.assign(figure=qa.figure.str.replace("_", " ", regex=False), **{"Off-canvas texts": qa.out_of_canvas.map(len), "Overlaps": qa.overlaps.map(len),
                       "Font sizes (pt)": qa.font_sizes_pt.map(lambda s: f"{min(s)}–{max(s)}")})
counts = rh.summary_counts("manuscript", "en")
kpis([
    (str(counts["figures"]), f"Panel figures regenerated by this page in {time.time() - started:.0f} s (English and Spanish plates)"),
    (str(counts["tables"]), "Tables of the article"),
    (str(counts["paragraphs"]), "Paragraphs (summary, research in context, introduction, methods, results, discussion and declarations)"),
    (str(counts["references"]), "Verified references"),
])
```

This page reproduces the **article** of the study as printed by version 10 of the manuscript. The text, the numbered citations and the two tables come from `docs/lancet/data/contenido_v10.json`, exported by the document builder with every figure already resolved against the verified facts file. The four panel figures are **not copies**: each time this page is rendered, `docs/lancet/figuras_principales.py` rebuilds them from the public tables of `docs/lancet/data/` (copies of the tidy outputs and of the verified data of revision 10, plus a commune extract without identifiers), with the same code that produced the submitted plates. Every plate links to its 175 mm PNG (300 dpi), SVG and PDF files, in English; the Spanish plates and text are generated alongside and kept in the same folders.

Case definition: GRD episodes with an eligible F84 code, excluding Rett syndrome (F84.2); REM programmes with the strict autism code except where "F84 family" is indicated. All counts are administrative recognition, not prevalence or incidence. Statements in square brackets are decisions pending from the authors. The [supplementary material](lancet_supplement.html) reproduces the extended methods, the complementary results, tables S1–S9 and figures S1–S9; the [extended corpus](lancet_corpus.html) collects the plates and tables of the earlier versions of the study.

show_table(qa_view[["figure", "language", "width_mm", "height_mm", "Font sizes (pt)", "Off-canvas texts", "Overlaps"]].rename(columns={
    "figure": "Figure", "language": "Language", "width_mm": "Width (mm)", "height_mm": "Height (mm)"}),
    "Layout check of the plates generated in this render (text outside the canvas and overlaps between labels must be zero)",
    {"Width (mm)": 1, "Height (mm)": 1})
